from solution import sum_series
import inspect


def test_issue_example_6():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 12 for n=6."""
    assert sum_series(6) == 12  # 6+4+2


def test_issue_odd_5():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 9 for n=5."""
    assert sum_series(5) == 9  # 5+3+1


def test_issue_odd_7():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 16 for n=7."""
    assert sum_series(7) == 16  # 7+5+3+1


def test_issue_even_8():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 20 for n=8."""
    assert sum_series(8) == 20  # 8+6+4+2


def test_issue_even_10():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 30 for n=10."""
    assert sum_series(10) == 30  # 10+8+6+4+2


def test_issue_small_1():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 1 for n=1."""
    assert sum_series(1) == 1  # 1


def test_issue_small_2():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 2 for n=2."""
    assert sum_series(2) == 2  # 2


def test_issue_small_3():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 4 for n=3."""
    assert sum_series(3) == 4  # 3+1


def test_issue_small_4():
    """Sum n+(n-2)... until n-x =< 0 gives 6 for n=4."""
    assert sum_series(4) == 6  # 4+2


def test_issue_zero_boundary():
    """Sum of positive integers is empty so 0 when n is 0."""
    assert sum_series(0) == 0  # no positive terms


def test_contract_callable_signature():
    """Public interface keeps sum_series(n) callable with one argument."""
    assert callable(sum_series)
    assert len(inspect.signature(sum_series).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Public interface sum_series returns sum as an integer."""
    assert isinstance(sum_series(6), int)  # 6+4+2 = 12 is int
